blas.backend: scipy-openblas (OpenBLAS, statically linked into the numpy wheel)
blas.openblas_configuration: OpenBLAS 0.3.31.188.0 USE64BITINT DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY Haswell MAX_THREADS=64
blas.note: DYNAMIC_ARCH: OpenBLAS auto-selects the best-matching SIMD kernel for the host CPU at runtime (the 'Haswell' string is the build's baseline target label, not necessarily the kernel actually dispatched on this Zen5 host) -- a residual native-instruction path independent of leafblower's own build flags (DESIGN.md Sec5).

leafblower_build.note: Single current build: -O3, NO -march=native (no CPU-specific dispatch flag set) -- closer to 'portable' than 'native' but does not literally match the DESIGN's assumed CRAN/PyPI default of -O2; flagged as a discrepancy for the WU that builds the second (native, -O3 -march=native) Python variant.

thread_env_convention.MKL_NUM_THREADS: must be set to 1 together with the above
